title: Heavier and lighter
examples: Teacher, how do I know which thing is heavier?
Can we use the balance to compare toys?
If one side goes down, does that mean it is heavier?

explain.say: We can use a balance to compare things.
If both sides are level, the things weigh the same.
When one side goes down, that side has the heavier thing.
If the side with the book goes down, the book is heavier.
If the feather side goes down, the feather is heavier.
If you put a small toy on one side and a big book on the other, the side with the book will go down.

faq.q: How do I know if something is heavier or lighter?
faq.a: You can use a balance scale to compare two things. If one side goes down, that side has the heavier object.

faq.q: Does the size of something tell me if it is heavy?
faq.a: No, size does not always tell you the weight. A small rock can be heavier than a big piece of fluff.

faq.q: What happens if the things weigh the same?
faq.a: If the things weigh the same, the balance scale will stay perfectly level.
asks: What does a level scale mean?
If it is straight, what is it?

faq.q: Can I use this for toys?
faq.a: Yes, you can use it to compare the weights of different toys you have.
asks: Is it okay to compare toys?

faq.q: Is there a special tool for weighing?
faq.a: The balance scale is a tool that helps us compare the weights of two objects.
asks: What is the tool for weighing?

facts: A balance scale helps us compare the weights of two objects.
If one side of the scale goes down, it means that side is heavier.
If the scale is level, the two objects weigh the same.
Weight is how much gravity pulls on an object.

quiz.say: If a pencil and a big book are on the scale, and the book side goes down, which is heavier?

options.show: It depends on how hard you push
options.say: It depends on how hard you push

quiz.why: The side that goes down shows the heavier object because it is pulled down more by gravity.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the scale measures the actual weight, not how hard you push it.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the scale shows the book side is lower, meaning the book is heavier.
wrong.3: This is wrong because if they weighed the same, the scale would stay perfectly level.

quiz.say: A feather and a small stone are placed on the scale. If the stone side goes down, what can you say?
quiz.why: The side that drops lower is always the side holding the heavier item.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the balance scale is designed exactly to tell us which is heavier.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the scale shows the stone side is lower, which means the stone is heavier.
wrong.3: This is wrong because if they weighed the same, the scale would not tilt at all.

quiz.say: Which word means the same as 'weigh the same' on the balance scale?
quiz.why: When the scale is level, it means both sides are pulling down equally, so they weigh the same.

wrong.0: This means one side is heavier, not that they are equal.
wrong.1: This means one side is heavier than the other side.
wrong.2: This word does not describe the balance scale's reading for equal weight.
